title: Sustainability Annual Report
executiveSummary: In 2024 Energo delivered a 23 percent reduction in greenhouse gas emissions year on year while growing adjusted earnings to USD 23 billion. Renewables pipeline additions reached 6 GW and gross capital expenditure to transition solutions rose to 15 percent. Safety performance improved with a serious incident frequency of 0.2 per million hours worked.
